claim.claim-text: 1. A device (1) for photon counting comprising:

a CMOS image sensor (10) including a plurality of pixels (11) each including a photoelectric conversion element (12) configured to convert input light to charge, and an amplifier (13) configured to amplify the charge converted by the photoelectric conversion element (12) and convert the charge to a voltage, wherein a readout noise of the CMOS image sensor (10) is equal to or less than 0.4 e-rms; an A/D converter (15) configured to convert the voltages output from the amplifiers (13) of the plurality of pixels to digital values; and a conversion unit (22) configured to convert the digital value output from the A/D converter (15) to the number of photons by referring to reference data, for each of the plurality of pixels (11), wherein the reference data is threshold value data for distinguishing between adjacent numbers of photons.
2. The device (1) according to claim 1, wherein the threshold value data is created based on a gain and an offset value of each of the plurality of pixels (11).

3. The device (1) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the conversion unit (22) is configured to convert the digital value of only the pixels of which the readout noise is equal to or less than 0.4 e-rms.
4. The device (1) according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein readout noise of the amplifier (13) is equal to or less than 0.2 [e-rms].
5. The device (1) according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein readout noise of the amplifier (13) is equal to or less than 0.15 [e-rms].
6. The device (1) according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the gain is equal to or more than 10 [DN/e].

7. The device (1) according to any one of claims 1 to 6, further comprising: a data processing unit (25) configured to create a two-dimensional image indicating the number of photons in each pixel based on the number of photons.

8. The device (1) according to any one of claims 1 to 6, further comprising: a data processing unit (25) configured to create a histogram that is a plot of the number of pixels with respect to the number of photons.
9. The device (1) according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the CMOS image sensor (10) includes the A/D converter (15).
10. The device (1) according to claim 9, wherein the A/D converter (15) is provided in each pixel.
11. A method for photon counting comprising:
12. The method according to claim 11, wherein the threshold value data is created based on a gain and an offset value of each of the plurality of pixels (11).
13. The method according to claim 11 or 12, wherein the converting converts the digital value of only the pixels of which the readout noise is equal to or less than 0.4 e-rms.
14. The method according to any one of claims 11 to 13, further comprising: creating a two-dimensional image indicating the number of photons in each pixel based on the number of photons.
15. The method according to any one of claims 11 to 14, further comprising: creating a histogram that is a plot of the number of pixels with respect to the number of photons.
